_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pterodactyl/game-eggs' Vintage Story egg (MIT).
name: Vintage Story
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The uncompromising wilderness survival sandbox. Installs the stable, unstable or pre-release server version you choose from vintagestory.at.
startup: read -r need 2>/dev/null < .raptor-dotnet || need=8; if ! dotnet --list-runtimes | grep -q "^Microsoft.NETCore.App $need\."; then echo "This Vintage Story version needs .NET $need, which this image doesn't have. Choose .NET $need in Startup, then start the server again."; exit 1; fi; exec dotnet VintagestoryServer.dll --dataPath ./data --port {{SERVER_PORT}} --maxclients {{MAX_CLIENTS}} {{OPTIONS}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Vintage Story. Downloads the Linux server from vintagestory.at and checks
# it against the published MD5. Worlds, settings and mods (all in data/)
# are never touched; the game's own files are only replaced once the new
# version has downloaded and checked out.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

branch="${FILES_BRANCH:-stable}"
want="${RELEASE_VERSION:-latest}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
rm -rf "$build"
mkdir -p "$build"

sum=""
if [ "$branch" = pre ]; then
    # Pre-releases aren't in the version list: the version has to be named.
    [ "$want" != latest ] || fail "Pre-releases have no latest: set Version to the pre-release you want, such as 1.22.0-pre.1."
    version=$want
    url="https://cdn.vintagestory.at/gamefiles/pre/vs_server_linux-x64_$version.tar.gz"
    code=$(curl -sS --retry 3 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I "$url") || fail "vintagestory.at can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    [ "$code" = 200 ] || fail "Vintage Story has no pre-release $version."
else
    list=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 "https://api.vintagestory.at/$branch.json") || fail "vintagestory.at can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
        version=$(jq -r 'to_entries | map(select(.value.linuxserver)) | .[0].key // empty' <<<"$list")
        [ -n "$version" ] || fail "vintagestory.at lists no $branch server right now. Reinstall to try again later."
    else
        jq -e --arg v "$want" 'has($v) and (.[$v].linuxserver != null)' <<<"$list" >/dev/null ||
            fail "Vintage Story has no $branch version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a version such as $(jq -r 'keys_unsorted[0]' <<<"$list")."
        version=$want
    fi
    url=$(jq -r --arg v "$version" '.[$v].linuxserver.urls.cdn // .[$v].linuxserver.urls.local' <<<"$list")
    sum=$(jq -r --arg v "$version" '.[$v].linuxserver.md5 // empty' <<<"$list")
fi

if [ -f VintagestoryServer.dll ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-vintagestory 2>/dev/null)" = "$version $sum" ] && [ "$branch" != pre ]; then
    echo "Vintage Story $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Vintage Story $version"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/server.tar.gz" "$url" || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    if [ -n "$sum" ] && [ "$(md5sum "$build/server.tar.gz" | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "$sum" ]; then
        fail "The download didn't match vintagestory.at's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    mkdir "$build/x"
    tar -xzf "$build/server.tar.gz" -C "$build/x"
    [ -f "$build/x/VintagestoryServer.dll" ] || fail "The download didn't contain the server. Reinstall to try again."
    rm -f "$build/x/server.sh"
    # Files a version dropped would still load, so the game's own folders
    # are replaced whole. Your worlds, settings and mods live in data/.
    rm -rf assets Lib
    cp -a "$build/x/." /mnt/server/
    echo "$version $sum" > .raptor-vintagestory
fi
mkdir -p data/Backups
# The .NET version it needs, which the startup command checks.
jq -r '.runtimeOptions.framework.version' VintagestoryServer.runtimeconfig.json | cut -d. -f1 > .raptor-dotnet
echo "Installed Vintage Story $version. It needs .NET $(cat .raptor-dotnet)."

variables.name: Branch
variables.description: stable, unstable, or pre for a pre-release (which needs a Version).

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The game version to install, such as 1.22.7, or latest.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can join at once.

variables.name: Options
variables.description: More command-line options for the server.

variables.name: SQLite temporary folder
variables.description: Where the world database keeps temporary files, such as during /db vacuum, so they don't fill the small temporary folder.
